basic_details.job_title: Tezpur University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tezpur University has published the Assistant Professor Notification 2026 on its official website, https://www.tezpuruniversity.ac.in. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 Assistant Professor position. Candidates holding a Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject along with NET/ SET/ SLET qualification or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations are eligible to submit their applications through email up to 12-08-2026. Candidates can easily access the notification PDF and application details below.

age_limit.details: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks in relevant subject, NET/SET/SLET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations
qualification.details: Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent) in concerned/relevant/allied subject from Indian University or equivalent from accredited foreign university. NET/SET/SLET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016. PhD desirable in relevant field/subject. Preference for ODL experience with IT skills.

selection_process: Shortlisting based on Academic Score Personal Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Tezpur University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Tezpur University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tezpur University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Tezpur University Assistant Professor positions is 12th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject, along with NET/SET/SLET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations. A PhD in the relevant field is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Professor position at Tezpur University as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Professor position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Tezpur University Assistant Professor recruitment must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the email is sent to the designated address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Tezpur University Assistant Professor recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting candidates based on their academic scores, followed by a personal interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor position at Tezpur University is a contractual role. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Tezpur University located?
faq.answer: Tezpur University is located in Tezpur, Assam, with the pincode 784028.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any specific preferences for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates with Open and Distance Learning (ODL) experience and relevant IT skills, in addition to the core qualifications.
